verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents agent-initiated stablecoin payments over named rails. The x402 guide covers signing a stablecoin payment from a USDC-funded Base wallet and reading back an onchain settlement receipt. A separate MPP flow pays via Tempo, and a quickstart sends USDXM from a user-owned wallet using a delegated agent signer. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that settlement works in production, and explicit confirmation of which stablecoin settles over the MPP/Tempo rail.

support.subject: As a developer, I can settle agent-initiated payments in stablecoins over documented rails
